description: Publishes a page from raw `html` or `markdown` (rendered server-side into safe HTML with the account template). Creates the slug or republishes it as a new version (previous versions are kept). `model` is required. New pages are private by default. Republishing keeps title, tags, summary, description, contentType, visibility, draft and TTL unless they are sent. expectedVersion makes the publish fail with 409 version_conflict if the page changed since it was read. draft:true keeps it private until outbox_go_live.

contentType.description: Free content type: briefing | report | notes | post | mockup | ...

draft.description: true = draft: effectively private until outbox_go_live

expectedVersion.description: Version that was read: the `version` returned by outbox_pull (or outbox_export / outbox_versions, read BEFORE the content). If the page changed since, the publish fails with 409 version_conflict

file_path.description: Local .html/.md file (relative to OUTBOX_FILES_DIR). Mutually exclusive with html/markdown

html.description: Raw HTML (served as-is; max 5 MB). Mutually exclusive with markdown

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key. Reuse the same key when retrying the same write (e.g. after a timeout) so it is not applied twice. Omitted = generated

inheritFolderVisibility.description: true = inherit the visibility of the closest folder

markdown.description: Markdown source, rendered server-side to safe HTML. Mutually exclusive with html

model.description: Required: id of the model that generated the content (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8')

notifySlack.description: Slack channel to notify, e.g. '#team' (not a URL)

owner.description: Handle of a team/org the account belongs to, to publish under that namespace. Omitted = own namespace

rejectOnSecrets.description: true = if the content appears to include credentials (API keys, tokens, private keys) it is NOT published (422 secrets_detected with type and line). Omitted = it is published and the result warns in warnings.secrets

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

summary.description: Short summary (derived from the title when missing on a new page)

tags.description: Tags (max 20; each 1-50 chars of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', no spaces). Stored in lowercase

ttl.description: Visibility TTL (e.g. '24h', '7d'); the page reverts to private when it expires. Non-private only

visibility.description: private / unlisted / public. Omitted: private for new pages, unchanged when republishing

name: outbox_publish
title: Outbox: publish HTML or Markdown
